title: The 9-12-15 Right Triangle
description: Scaling up the classic 3-4-5 triangle to see the Pythagorean theorem still holds.
narration_lines: A right triangle has legs of 9 and 12. What's the longest side?
Square each leg: 9 squared is 81, 12 squared is 144.
The square root of 225 is 15 -- just the 3-4-5 triangle scaled up by 3.

params.hook: A right triangle with legs 9 and 12?
params.footnote: it's the classic 3-4-5 triangle, scaled up by 3
